vendor: Insider One (Sosyo Plus Bilgi Bilişim - Turkey; Insider Benelux B.V. - EU/EEA; regional entities globally)
product_family: Insider One: AI-powered customer engagement platform with unified CDP, personalization engine, journey orchestration, behavioral analytics, and multi-channel activation (SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Web, App, Push, Search).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Insider has successfully completed the SOC 2 Type 2 examination covering the Insider One Growth Management Platform for the period April 2023 through March 2024, assessing Security, Availability, and Confidentiality.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001:2022 Information Security Management System Certificate confirms adherence to globally recognized best practices for protecting confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Insider One is 100% GDPR compliant with data privacy and security at the core of the technology and culture. ePrivacy Seal continuously held since 2020, validated every three years.

certifications.name: ePrivacy Seal
certifications.proof_quote: Insider has continuously held the ePrivacy Seal since 2020 as validation of GDPR and ePrivacy Directive compliance through comprehensive assessment of data processing and organizational safeguards.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Insider One provides Business Associate Agreements upon request, with administrative, physical, and technical safeguards including AWS encryption and employee training protocols.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification found on vendor domain despite handling customer payment and ecommerce data.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Registry
certifications.proof_quote: Insider One holds certifications including ISO 27001, CSA STAR Registry, SOC 2 Type 2, and the e-Privacy seal.

privacy.ai_training_note: Insider One explicitly commits in its DPA (dated June 2025) that it shall NOT use Customer Data, including prompts, inputs, AI Outputs, or other Personal Data, for training, fine-tuning, or developing/improving AI or ML models except where expressly agreed. This applies to anonymized, pseudonymized, or aggregated data.
privacy.data_region: EU-West-1 (Ireland) via AWS; regional controllers in Turkey, EU/EEA, and other jurisdictions; customers can select EU data residency.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES256 encryption algorithm in RDS (Relational Database Service); unique personal data encryption keys

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Multi-factor authentication required; role-based access controls with regular audits; IP-based session restrictions; 30-minute inactivity timeout; 1-day maximum session duration; account lockout after failed login attempts

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on AWS with layered defense (Firewall, VPN, segregation); data segregation across separate cloud services and regions; 24/7 monitoring by Network Operations Center

security.name: Zero Trust Network Access
security.value: Enterprise Risk Management Program; Secure Software Development Life Cycle; Technical Vulnerability Management; Incident Management & Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery; regular penetration testing

security.name: DDoS Mitigation
security.value: DDoS mitigation included in default security features
